statements.venue: Bloomberg Television interview with Francine Lacqua (Leaders With Lacqua)

statements.text: AI has been a central policy focus of the President and the Congress for the past few years. President Biden has taken the lead in addressing AI’s prospects and problems, receiving intellectual, business and community leaders to share their views. In the House of Representatives and the U.S. Senate, we early on brought in academics, entrepreneurs and leaders from the public, private and non-profit sectors to express AI’s opportunities and challenges.
statements.venue: Press release, Pelosi statement opposing California SB 1047

statements.text: The review is coming down to if and what standards and guardrails should Congress legislate. In addition to focusing on protections, we wanted to pursue improving AI.
statements.venue: Press release, Pelosi statement opposing California SB 1047

statements.text: While we want California to lead in AI in a way that protects consumers, data, intellectual property and more, SB 1047 is more harmful than helpful in that pursuit.
statements.venue: Press release, Pelosi statement opposing California SB 1047

statements.text: AI springs from California. We must have legislation that is a model for the nation and the world. We have the opportunity and responsibility to enable small entrepreneurs and academia – not big tech – to dominate.
statements.venue: Press release, Pelosi statement opposing California SB 1047

statements.text: California is the home, the birthplace of AI. In our view. It has the knowledge, the technological knowledge, it has the entrepreneurship, and it has the responsibility to do the right thing, not to pass a bill that does not do the job because it is as well-intentioned as it is ill-informed.

AI springs from California. Thank you, @CAgovernor Newsom, for recognizing the opportunity and responsibility we all share to enable small entrepreneurs and academia – not big tech – to dominate.

https://t.co/9CSwLjgpnT

On Friday, I joined Bay Area students at the AI Bootcamp in San Francisco hosted by @CongressionalAC and @SeedAIOrg.
 
With creativity and purpose, these young innovators are proving that the next generation can use technology to expand opportunities and solve problems. https://t.co/2VhcESxSEt

Women have spent generations fighting to have our own voices heard in the halls of power. 

We should not have to now fight against artificial intelligence putting words in our mouths. https://t.co/B6Vlu1ww3V

AI is on a path to shape America’s future, and we must get the policy right. I welcome Project Blueprint’s effort to bring technology leaders and policymakers together to build practical, bipartisan guardrails that protect Americans while ensuring we lead in this transformative technology.

I have great confidence in Ron Conway’s patriotism and commitment to work for solutions that are “durable enough to survive changes in power.”
statements.quoted:
Breaking in @dealbook: Jay Carney is joining SV Angel, Ron Conway’s venture capital firm, to run a new initiative called Project Blueprint. Its purpose is to rebuild bonds between leaders in the artificial intelligence sector and Democrats who are demanding new rules to regulate the technology.
